facts.fact: The Minister of Economy, Commerce, Industry and Digital Transition held a strategic consultation in Praia on 6 August 2026 whose contributions are to deepen the national diagnosis and support the priorities and measures of the future digital transformation agenda, which the document describes as cross-government and not yet written.
facts.system: futura agenda de transformação digital do país

facts.fact: On 6 August 2026 the government convened public administration, private sector, academia and experts in a consultation on digital transformation (interoperability, service digitisation, skills, innovation, inclusion, data protection, cybersecurity) to feed the future agenda.
facts.system: futura agenda de transformação digital do país
